sights.w: Launched family coaster (2024) that replaced Antarctica: Empire of the Penguin — snowmobile cars at up to 43 mph ending at a real penguin habitat in the Sea of Ice area (Wikipedia; SeaWorld official).

sights.address: SeaWorld Orlando, 7007 Sea World Dr, Orlando, FL
sights.w: The USA's first water coaster (opened April 1998, Mack Rides) — a dark-ride/water-coaster hybrid themed to the lost city of Atlantis in the Sea of Legends area (Wikipedia; SeaWorld official calls it the world's first water coaster).

sights.w: Open-air I-Drive entertainment & dining complex beside the Orange County Convention Center — IMAX/4DX cinema, WonderWorks, Main Event and a restaurant cluster incl. Taverna Opa (Wikipedia; Tasty Chomps' Dec 2025 dining & nightlife guide).
sights.k: i-drive shopping dining nightlife entertainment complex convention center

sights.w: Free, award-winning city park between historic downtown Kissimmee and Lake Tohopekaliga — fishing pier, boardwalks, splash pad and Big Toho Marina on one of the nation's top bass lakes; sandhill cranes, egrets and the odd gator along the shore (City of Kissimmee; Experience Kissimmee).
